designSystem.styleGuidelines:
## Brand & Style

This design system establishes a cinematic, high-end editorial studio environment tailored for video creators, art directors, and kinetic typography artists. The atmosphere is that of an upscale color-grading suite meets a Swiss typesetting atelier: disciplined, focused, and dramatically restrained.

The core visual philosophy relies on:
- **Cinematic Chiaroscuro:** Deep charcoal backdrops that eliminate eye fatigue during long editing sessions and let media content take absolute center stage.
- **Editorial High-Fashion Meets Precision Audio Tool:** Combining expressive, literary serif display type with hyper-legible, calibrated monospace and sans-serif metadata.
- **Restrained Vermilion Focus:** A single, sharp vermilion/crimson signature accent reserved exclusively for time-critical states—such as active speech tokens, playhead needles, audio peak alerts, and primary export triggers.
- **Tectonic Rigidity:** Razor-sharp 1px boundary lines, crisp 8px corner radii, and zero decorative fluff. Surfaces feel precision-milled rather than painted or soft.

## Layout & Spacing

The studio layout uses a strict three-panel anchor system designed for maximum viewport focus on vertical (9:16) video creation:

### Three-Panel Studio Topology
1. **Left Track / Transcript Inspector (320px fixed):** Word-level script sequencing, voice-to-text timing anchors, kinetic style selector.
2. **Center Canvas (Fluid):** Floating dark stage dedicated to the 9:16 portrait viewport (aspect locked, responsive scale with safe zones for TikTok/Reels overlays).
3. **Right Properties Panel (280px fixed):** Motion physics, spring-damping curves, font kerning, drop shadow depth, and color palettes.
4. **Bottom Timeline (280px fixed height):** Horizontal audio waveform lanes, sentence segment blocks, and word-level micro chips pinned below the canvas.

### Breakpoints & Adaptive Reflow
- **Desktop Studio (>= 1280px):** Full 4-quadrant layout with persistent timeline and dual sidebars.
- **Tablet Studio (768px – 1279px):** Inspector collapses to an off-canvas drawer; center canvas and timeline maintain persistent split screen.
- **Mobile Director (< 768px):** Single-column stacked mode. Center preview leads top-screen (aspect scaled to 40vh); bottom sheet handles transcript word tapping and scrubbing.

## Elevation & Depth

This system avoids bulbous dropshadows, diffuse colored glows, or skeuomorphic bevels. Visual separation is achieved strictly through tonal value stacking, razor-thin borders, and low-intensity ambient occlusions.

### Depth Hierarchy
- **Level 0 (Flat Canvas):** `#0B0B0C`. No border, zero elevation.
- **Level 1 (Docked Shell Panels):** `#131316`. Bounded by 1px solid `#26262B`. No shadow.
- **Level 2 (Active Cards & Floating Palettes):** `#1A1A1E`. Border: 1px solid `#26262B`. Shadow: `0px 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45)`.
- **Level 3 (Modals, Context Menus, Scrubber Callouts):** `#222227`. Border: 1px solid `#34343C`. Shadow: `0px 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7)`.

### Optical Highlights & Overlays
- **Playhead Needle:** A clean 1.5px vertical line in `#EF4444` carrying a subtle blur glow (`box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.5)`) to maintain visibility over dense multi-colored waveforms.
- **Video Safe Frame:** 1px dashed `#52525B` inner boundary overlaid at 9:16 representing device UI occlusion safe areas (story captions, like buttons, profile pills).

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary Studio Action (Export / Render):** Background `#EF4444`, text `#FFFFFF`, font `Geist` Medium 13px, border 1px solid `#DC2626`, radius 6px, padding `8px 16px`. Hover: `#F87171`. Active: `#B91C1C`.
- **Secondary Tool Button:** Background `#1A1A1E`, text `#F4F4F6`, border 1px solid `#26262B`, radius 6px, padding `8px 14px`. Hover: background `#222227`, border `#3F3F46`.
- **Ghost / Icon Action:** Background transparent, text `#A1A1AA`, radius 4px, padding `6px`. Hover: background `#1A1A1E`, text `#F4F4F6`.

### Word-Level Caption Chips (Transcript & Timeline)
- **Inactive Word Slug:** Background `#131316`, border 1px solid `#26262B`, text `#A1A1AA`, font `Geist` 13px, padding `4px 8px`, border radius `4px`.
- **Active Speech Voicing:** Background `rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.14)`, border 1px solid `#EF4444`, text `#FFFFFF`, font weight 600.
- **Hero Emphasis Word:** Typography switches to italicized `Playfair Display`, text `#F4F4F6`, with a 2px underline in `#EF4444`.

### Input Fields & Scrub Sliders
- **Numeric & Timecode Inputs:** Background `#0B0B0C`, border 1px solid `#26262B`, font `JetBrains Mono` 12px, text `#F4F4F6`, radius 6px, padding `6px 10px`. Focus: border 1px solid `#EF4444`.
- **Parametric Slider (Damping, Scale, Speed):** Track height 3px in `#26262B`. Filled progress in `#EF4444`. Thumb: 12px square with a 2px radius, `#F4F4F6` fill, no shadow.

### Checkboxes & Switch Toggles
- **Checkbox:** 14px x 14px square, radius 3px, border 1px solid `#3F3F46`, background `#0B0B0C`. Checked: background `#EF4444`, border `#EF4444` with a sharp white checkmark.
- **Kinetic Toggle:** 32px width x 18px height. Track background `#26262B`. Thumb: 12px x 12px `#F4F4F6` with 2px offset. Active track: `#EF4444`.

### 9:16 Video Preview Card
- Multi-layered frame: outer matte in `#0B0B0C`, video canvas border 1px solid `#26262B`. Centered aspect ratio 9:16 with letterbox margin.
- Floating overlay controls (Play/Pause, Loop, Safe Zone HUD) docked via semi-translucent slate surface (`rgba(19, 19, 22, 0.85)` with `backdrop-filter: blur(8px)` and 1px border `#26262B`).

### Audio Waveform Track
- Container: Background `#131316`, border-t 1px solid `#26262B`.
- Waveform Bars: Default speech frequency drawn in `#2E2E36`; active voiced sections dynamically filled in `#EF4444`.
- Playhead Scrubber: Crisp `#EF4444` vertical needle topped with an inverted polygon arrow carrying the millisecond counter tooltip.

## Brand & Style

This design system establishes a cinematic, high-end editorial studio environment tailored for video creators, art directors, and kinetic typography artists. ## Colors

The palette operates under strict dark-mode discipline. Color is never decorative; it is functional, semantic, and narrative.

### Surface Tiers
- **Canvas Base (`#0B0B0C`):** Root application background, canvas margins, and viewport surrounds.
- **Surface Elevation 1 (`#131316`):** Sidebar panels, bottom timeline shell, inspector drawers.
- **Surface Elevation 2 (`#1A1A1E`):** Floating tool palettes, waveform container plates, modal containers, and transcript row backgrounds.
- **Surface Elevation 3 (`#222227`):** Hover states on list items, active tool toggles, and popover panels.

### Borders & Structural Separators
- **Border Default (`#26262B`):** 1px structural hairpins defining timeline tracks, preview viewport boundaries, and inspector panel splitters.
- **Border Subtle (`#1C1C20`):** Secondary dividers inside grouped lists and sub-controls.
- **Border Active/Focus (`#EF4444`):** Focused word transcript tokens, scrubber handles, and active inputs.

### Typographic Contrast
- **Text Primary (`#F4F4F6`):** High-clarity warm ivory for headline typography, active captions, and modal titles.
- **Text Secondary (`#A1A1AA`):** Cool zinc for inactive subtitles, tool labels, and secondary parameter readout.
- **Text Tertiary / Muted (`#52525B`):** Millisecond timestamps, shortcuts, track rulers, and audio frame indices.

### The Focal Accent (Vermilion Studio Red)
- **Accent Primary (`#EF4444`):** Scrubber needle, live record state, export confirmation, and currently voiced word highlights.
- **Accent Hover (`#F87171`):** Interactive hover states for primary kinetic badges.
- **Accent Deep / Muted (`#991B1B`):** Timeline region selections, kinetic speed ramp curves, and subtle audio waveform active fills.
- **Accent Tint (`rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12)`): Active speech token background pill, playhead shadow glow.

## Typography

Typography drives the core product experience. The hierarchy establishes a deliberate dichotomy between **Editorial Narrative Art** (`Playfair Display`), **Engine Precision** (`Geist`), and **Timecode Caliber** (`JetBrains Mono`).

### Type Roles
- **Hero Kinetic Display (`Playfair Display`):** Reserved for viewport caption overlays, active speech title treatments, and top-tier project branding. In preview containers, words in this face command instant artistic reverence.
- **Interface & Tool Controls (`Geist`):** Delivers clean optical balance across sliders, dropdowns, inspector properties, and modal instructions. High x-height ensures readability at sub-14px sizes.
- **Audio & Timecode Readouts (`JetBrains Mono`):** Every timestamp (`00:01:24.12`), millisecond start/end anchor, frames-per-second indicator, and audio decibel metric must render in monospace to prevent layout jitter during scrub playback.

## Layout & Spacing

- **Level 3 (Modals, Context Menus, Scrubber Callouts):** `#222227`. Border: 1px solid `#34343C`. Shadow: `0px 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7)`.

- **Action Buttons & Inputs:** Restrained `6px` radius.
